primary_route: Three-probability single-unit task with response-based dopamine selection.

checks.reason: No explicit commitment to consult/check prior primary Methods or a validated technical protocol for pre-execution settings and transfer is made; local calibration and preregistration alone do not meet M.

Core preparation/recording, delivery magnitude and behavioral acquisition settings lack a complete executable quantitative workflow or concrete calibration-to-setting procedure; listing parameters to freeze later is insufficient.
Timing, delivery, identity and stability checks lack numerical acceptance-to-action thresholds or a concrete derivation of tolerances before the main contrast.
The hierarchical conceptual model does not specify a likelihood/dispersion decision with diagnostics and a concrete multiplicity procedure across the several primary comparisons.
Technical/training changes are not explicitly followed by a revised frozen analysis/protocol and fresh independent confirmation.
No complete raw-trial/unit manifest with exact analysis/acquisition versions/settings, calibration records and all technical/biological losses is specified.
Population identity/eligibility depends on the target reward/omission response, with no independent tagging or molecular identification and no cue-identity, movement or matched-value controls.

No actual independently identified preparation, welfare-approved prerequisite or concrete validation route is selected. Region targeting and reward-response criteria alone are not a qualified experimental population.
Fifty neurons is called a power threshold without independent-animal variance, meaningful effect or power calculation; trials/neurons cannot replace biological replication.
Trial interleaving and blinded sorting are useful, but cue identity is fixed to probability with no across-animal counterbalancing or balanced session allocation.
The only failure response reclassifies/excludes neurons or extends training. No technical delivery/timing/identity diagnostic repair and retest sequence is provided.
Non-significance is interpreted as strict absence of waiting information rather than a precision-bounded null; no meaningful-effect or equivalence decision is specified.
No independent/orthogonal confirmation cohort, held-out model test or independent population-identification validation is supplied.
Baseline firing is conflated with neuronal silence: absence of task modulation does not imply zero spontaneous spiking.
The positive mechanism bundles uncertainty and expected value instead of an operational discriminating value-matched test; motor/timing alternatives are not tested.
